headline: Asia's tech rout sends money into the INDOGB 2–4Y sector, down 6–8bp, while the 10Y holds at 7.70% and ignores a 5bp Treasury rally
summary: A second day of belly buying, this time on a regional risk-off day: PHEI's IGSYC 2Y fell 5.6bp to 7.047%, the 3Y 7.8bp to 7.197% and the 5Y 4.2bp to 7.472%, while the 1Y rose 1.9bp to 6.865% and the 10Y was flat at 7.703% (−0.1bp), still a day off its five-year high. 5s10s steepened to 23bp, the widest of the seven PHEI days stored, and 1s2s flattened to 18bp from 26bp; on the week the 5Y is 5bp lower but the 10Y 8bp and the 15–30Y 9bp higher. The curve fell more than the benchmarks: FR0109 rose 1.5bp to 7.363% and is now only 3bp rich (10bp on Thursday), FR0108 2.0bp to 7.631%. Sukuk were mixed (PBS030 −16bp, PBS040 16bp cheap to the curve, fitted PBS 5Y on IGSYC), the retail curve sits 14bp rich at 5Y, and AAA 3Y tightened to 49bp over IGSYC.
drivers: The belly rallied through an Asian tech rout

A US AI-stock sell-off took the Kospi down more than 8% and the Nikkei over 2% at the open. The JCI fell 2% in the morning but closed 0.4% higher at 5,050, with foreigners net buyers of Rp328bn of equities. The 2–4Y sector fell 6–8bp while duration stayed unwanted; who bought is not disclosed, so the read that risk-off money moved into short SBN is a hypothesis, not an established flow.
Rupiah steady, reserves up, so the front end held

Spot rupiah closed 0.04% weaker at 18,089 and JISDOR fixed at 18,130 (+0.2%), flat on the week; tanker attacks in the Middle East weighed intraday. October FX reserves rose $0.5bn to $146.8bn (5.3 months of imports) despite intervention, so BI is not short of ammunition. The 1Y rose 2bp to 112bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate as the Nov 18 meeting stays live.
A $3bn global sukuk eases the supply worry

The government priced $3bn of 3/5/10-year global sukuk at 5.45%, 5.85% and 6.25%, 2.9 times covered, funding part of the year-end need offshore after the Oct 27 SUN auction raised only Rp20.65tn against a Rp30tn target. That helps the long end at the margin, but 15–30Y yields did not move today.
US Treasuries: a 5bp rally the 10Y ignored

Thursday's New York session cut the US 10Y 5.5bp to 4.84% on the tech sell-off, worth about −1.6bp for INDOGBs at the 1-year daily beta of 0.29; the 10Y moved −0.1bp, so Treasuries explain none of today's belly rally and the long end lagged. Over four weeks the US 10Y is down 38bp while the INDOGB 10Y is up 47bp (26-week weekly beta −0.11: about +4bp is the Treasury-linked part and +43bp is residual; the residual is what the US move does not explain, not proof of domestic selling or political risk), and the INDOGB − UST spread widened to 286bp, a new 52-week high.
data: October FX reserves (Nov 6)
$146.8bn (f n/a, p $146.3bn); 5.3 months of imports
Up despite rupiah intervention, helped by government loans. My read, not a BI commitment: this gives BI room to keep smoothing the rupiah near 18,100–18,200 before it has to hike.
Q3 GDP (Nov 5)
A clear beat led by government spending: no growth case for BI to stay on hold, but it lowers the risk premium.
OJK October market data (Nov 5)
Non-resident SBN net buy Rp9.55tn; equity net sell Rp16.88tn; JCI −16.7% m/m

Bond money stayed while equity money left in October, so that month's INDOGB sell-off was a price move rather than a foreign exit; October inflows do not rule out foreign selling in November, which is not yet reported.
SBSN auction (Nov 3)
Bids Rp28.56tn, awarded Rp16.65tn (target Rp10tn); bid-to-cover 1.71x
Demand concentrated in short tenors; long sukuk were taken selectively, as today's flat PBS038 shows.
October CPI (Nov 2)
Softer than expected: inflation does not force BI's hand; the rupiah does.
SUN auction (Oct 27)
Bids Rp31.09tn (p Rp64.86tn), awarded Rp20.65tn vs Rp30tn target; FR0111 average 7.54% (p 7.24%)
The first miss of the target in two years: supply, not inflation, is what keeps the long end heavy.
BI board meeting (Oct 21)
BI-Rate 5.75% (hold); deposit facility raised to 5.00%; lending facility 6.50%
Tighter at the very front; the Nov 17–18 meeting is a close call.
view: This week's rally is a belly story, not a duration turn: the 2–5Y sector fell 6–8bp on domestic buying through a regional equity rout, but the 10Y is flat on the week's high (98th percentile of the past year) and ignored a 5bp Treasury rally, with US CPI (Nov 10), MSCI's review (Nov 11) and BI (Nov 17–18) ahead. The daily Bond Flow Signal is −1.09 (−1.22 Thursday; sell-off since Sep 30) and reads sell-off: the 10Y trend (z +2.32) and the JCI (z −2.09) dominate, the rupiah part is z +1.62 on a 3.3% weaker rupiah over 20 sessions, and the 286bp Treasury spread, 46bp above its 130-day average (z +1.69), is the one bond-bullish part; the call is 60bp right since Sep 30. The weekly build reads −0.68, also sell-off. Its record argues for respect, not faith: on the daily build since June 2022 it scores a Sharpe of 0.65 outright and 0.76 hedged against Treasuries, with rally calls right 58% and sell-off calls 51% of the time over the next 20 sessions (weekly build: 0.27 and 0.40). These are in-sample back-tests, not live results; the US-trend variants reach 0.81 on the weekly build but were chosen after the fact and are not live. the Treasury-linked part explains only about 4bp of the 47bp four-week rise, so the turn has to come from what the US move does not explain, the rupiah and BI; a week of foreign equity buying with JISDOR below 18,100 would likely lift the signal toward −0.5. I expect the 10Y at 7.55–7.85% over the next two weeks and stay underweight, covering half below 7.60%. On the curve, the belly has done the work: 5s10s at 23bp is the steepest of the stored days, so I would not add 5Y outright here, and I keep the FR0109 → PBS040 switch, 3.7bp against with PBS040 now 16bp cheap.

buckets.name: Front end 1–2Y vs BI-Rate
buckets.why: The IGSYC 1Y rose 1.9bp to 6.865%, 112bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate (57th percentile of seven stored days, average 113bp) and 187bp over the 5.00% deposit facility; the 2Y fell 5.6bp to 7.047%, so 1s2s flattened to 18bp from 26bp. The 1M point (0.1Y) held at 6.33% and the 3M (0.25Y) is 6.42%. Previous call (add at 1Y 7.10%) still open and unfilled, 24bp away.
buckets.call: Neutral. Keep the plan: add 1–2Y if the 1Y reaches 7.10% or once BI has hiked and JISDOR holds below 18,000; avoid chasing below 6.75%.

buckets.name: Belly 5Y (FR0109 / PBS040)
buckets.why: The IGSYC 5Y fell 4.2bp to 7.472% (29th percentile of seven stored days, average 7.531%), −5bp on the week, while the 3–4Y led at −6 to −8bp. FR0109 rose 1.5bp to 7.363% and is now 3bp rich (10bp Thursday); PBS040 rose 0.8bp to 7.500% and is 16bp cheap. The FR0109 → PBS040 switch, entered at 10bp, is 13.7bp: 3.7bp against, 2.3bp from the stop. The outright entry (FR0109 7.60–7.70%) was not filled.
buckets.call: Keep the switch (sell FR0109 / buy PBS040), target 4bp, stop 16bp: PBS040 at 16bp cheap to the curve is the widest yet. Outright: buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after a BI hike or with JISDOR below 18,000; target 7.35%, stop 7.95%.

buckets.name: 10Y outright
buckets.why: The IGSYC 10Y was flat (−0.1bp) at 7.703%, the 98th percentile of the past year (178 days, average 6.79%), +8bp on the week and +60bp since the daily sell-off signal started on Sep 30, so the underweight keeps working. FR0108 rose 2bp to 7.631%, 7bp rich to the curve. Cheap on history and on the 286bp spread to Treasuries (a 52-week high), but the daily flow signal still reads sell-off (−1.09) and the 10Y ignored a 5bp US rally.
buckets.call: Stay underweight; cover half if the 10Y closes below 7.60%, turn neutral when the signal rises above −0.5 or after a BI hike that steadies the rupiah. A tactical long only above 7.85% with a stop at 8.05%.

buckets.name: 10s20s curve (FR0108 vs FR0107)
buckets.why: IGSYC 10s20s held at 1.6bp (86th percentile of seven stored days, average 0.7bp); the whole 10–30Y sector moved −0.1bp. The benchmark spread FR0107 − FR0108 narrowed to 3.4bp from 4.2bp as FR0108 cheapened 2bp; the steepener re-entry at −5bp was not filled.
buckets.call: Wait. Re-enter the FR0108/FR0107 steepener duration-weighted only at −5bp or lower, target +5bp, stop −12bp.

buckets.name: PBS sukuk vs FR
buckets.stance: Neutral long end; PBS040 in the belly
buckets.why: The fitted PBS 5Y is 0.8bp through IGSYC (50th percentile of six stored days, average −2.4bp) and the 10Y 0.6bp over, the cheapest of those days; the fit rests on four series, so confidence is low. PBS030 fell 16bp to 6.887%, PBS034 rose 5.5bp to 7.676% (now 4.9bp rich, from 9.6bp) and PBS038 was unchanged at 7.710%. The switch-back condition (PBS034 5bp cheap) is not met.
buckets.call: Hold FR over PBS034 at the long end; switch back once PBS034 is 5bp cheap to the curve. In the belly, keep sell FR0109 / buy PBS040 (entry 10bp, now 13.7bp, target 4bp, stop 16bp; size small, PBS040 trades less).

buckets.name: Corporate credit (AAA 3Y)
buckets.why: PHEI's AAA 3Y fell 8.4bp to 7.691%, a touch more than IGSYC 3Y, so its spread is 49.5bp, the tightest of six stored days (17th percentile, average 51.5bp). AA is 86bp over and A 156bp, both steady, while BBB tightened again to 236bp over AA (240bp Thursday). The tightening looks like steady local demand, but buyer-level data is not published, so that is a hypothesis; only six days stored, so the meter is thin. The add level (AAA 3Y past 70bp) was not reached.
buckets.call: Hold AAA/AA; add only if AAA 3Y widens past 70bp. Avoid BBB until the rupiah stabilises; steady tightening is not a reason to chase.

buckets.name: Retail SBN 5Y (ORI/SR)
buckets.why: The fitted retail curve sits 14.4bp through IGSYC at 5Y, the least rich of six stored days (average −16.0bp, 28-bond fit), because retail holders rarely sell. Secondary spreads run from 49bp rich (SR022T3) to 31bp cheap (ORI026T6 at 7.541%). ST017 opened today until Dec 2 with floors of 6.95% (2Y) and 7.05% (4Y), below the IGSYC 2Y at 7.05% and 4Y at 7.35%.
buckets.call: For new money, FR0109 or PBS040 offer more yield with daily liquidity; ST017's floor suits only hold-to-maturity buyers who want BI-hike upside. Buy secondary retail only at the cheap end (ORI026T6, 31bp over IGSYC).

igs:10.note: Flat at 7.70%; ignored a 5bp UST rally

sbsn:5.note: Fitted; on the curve; PBS040 16bp cheap

retail:5.note: 14bp rich; least rich of six days

watch: Next: US October payrolls (tonight, Fri Nov 6), US CPI and the 10Y Treasury auction (Tue Nov 10), MSCI's index review (Nov 11, read in Jakarta Nov 12), settlement of the $3bn global sukuk (Nov 13), then BI's board meeting (Nov 17–18); JISDOR above 18,200 or a JCI break below 4,800 would bring a hike forward, a rupiah below 18,000 would push it out.
